title: Improved trailer: My ftp Sudoku Engine Builder
author: TheDungeonMaxter
selftext:
**9FOLD** is a roguelike engine-builder built around Sudoku, I built it using a combination of Open-AI, Claude, and base-44.

Every placement strengthens the engine you’re building. Millions of scoring synergies combine to create unique builds that transform simple moves into massive score cascades.

Every run is about discovering powerful combinations, scaling them to ridiculous heights, and chasing an even bigger score. You unlock more ways to play as you go, and higher difficulties.

Totally free, no ads: [9FOLD](http://9fold.net)
